prompts.grass: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: ONE square seamless ground material for a strictly top-down orthographic WW2 European hex strategy boardgame. Refined hand-painted illustration, matte natural colors, crisp small-scale texture and controlled fine detail, matching snowy terrain's visual detail density. Readable when reduced to 384x384 and viewed at 1:1 in game. Flat EVEN illumination everywhere, no vignette, no central composition, no perspective, no shadows from objects. Texture fills all edges. No text, no borders, no grid, no hexagon, no objects, no large forms, no blur, no watercolor wash, no pixel-art blocks, no photographic noise. Fine details must be coherent irregular natural marks, not random sharpened specks. Pale warm yellow-green European summer meadow, average color around #d5cf8b, creamy straw and sage green. Many tiny distinct short grass tufts and fine dry blades interwoven with small soil flecks, subtle medium-size natural variation. Keep the overall field LIGHT with moderate local microcontrast; no dark green lawn, no flowers or broad clover leaves, no big patches. The texture must stay a calm readable backdrop for dark olive trees and tank sprites, while being visibly finely drawn rather than blurry.
